metadata.Name: PxSLU
metadata.Description: A spoken drug prescription dataset in French for spoken language understanding
metadata.Paper Title: A Spoken Drug Prescription Dataset in French for Spoken Language Understanding
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
Affiliations: Univ. Grenoble Alpes, CNRS, Inria, Grenoble INP, LIG
Clinique de médecine gériatrique, CHU Grenoble Alpes
metadata.Abstract: Spoken medical dialogue systems are increasingly attracting interest to enhance access to healthcare services and improve quality and traceability of patient care. In this paper, we focus on medical drug prescriptions acquired on smartphones through spoken dialogue. Such systems would facilitate the traceability of care and would free clinicians' time. However, there is a lack of speech corpora to develop such systems since most of the related corpora are in text form and in English. To facilitate the research and development of spoken medical dialogue systems, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first spoken medical drug prescriptions corpus, named PxSLU.
